scientific_integrity: Exact finite exhaustive proof with signed integer Morse boundary and explicit unit minors; independent mod-two calculations are corroborative rather than the integral justification.
scientific_limitations: Only the two graphs GP(10,2) and GP(10,3), and only the first higher-independence (induced degree at most one) complexes, are classified. No automorphism module, general n,k formula, or external peer audit is asserted. Undiscovered equivalent literature is a residual risk.
title: Integral two-independence homotopy separates the dodecahedral and Desargues graphs
